# Yente Vanhoudt

> Portfolio of Yente Vanhoudt, a Digital Experience Design student and web designer from Belgium, working in web design, web development, UI/UX design and 3D design. The site is available in English and Dutch (add ?lang=nl).

## About
- [Home](https://yentevanhoudt.be/): introduction, services, selected work and tools.
- [About](https://yentevanhoudt.be/about.html): who Yente Vanhoudt is, a curious maker and creator of shaders and 3D scenes.
- [Contact](https://yentevanhoudt.be/contact.html): open for internships, projects or a first introduction. Email: yentevanhoudt@icloud.com

## Selected work
- [Tennis Blender Project](https://yentevanhoudt.be/work-tennis.html): a tennis-themed 3D project in Blender with renders, custom style frames and a short animation.
- [NEXT](https://yentevanhoudt.be/work-next.html): a custom-built website and content platform for a real youth-care client, made by a project team.
- [Mobile app for Busleyden Atheneum](https://yentevanhoudt.be/work-ba-app.html): an app concept with campus discovery, school news and a student mini-game.
